limits: One guest, one macOS version (27.0.1 arm64); Linux and Windows remain unproven, so no adoption claim follows.
Case-a0-base is the corrected original baseline; case-a-original and case-b-matched-node carry the disclosed guest-local specifier repair and are retained history/control respectively.

Byte-level equivalence is bounded by the bundle measurement: of 670 logical js/css assets under /assets/, 281 are byte-identical and 389 content-differing; the 8 size-differing pairs each lose exactly 6 bytes to one if(!!x)->if(x) (-2) and one new Error(->Error( (-4), and applying those two transforms to both sides leaves every content-differing pair with equal length, i.e. all remaining differences (minified names and content-hash tokens) are length-preserving and net 0. Nothing is claimed about the plans bundle beyond that, and the earlier masked-structure comparison cannot show name-only differences, so no name/hash-only statement is relied on.
Packaged .vsix archives and their .sig are per-build artifacts; even the two universal archives are identical only within the Node cases, and the darwin-arm64 archive differs everywhere.
Readiness is proven at the HTTP/WebSocket/MCP seams, the process level and the logs; no visual/UX judgement is claimed (no screenshots, no UI automation, no scrollback clearing).
The candidate-branch compatibility gap is documented, not repaired; 09 owns the adoption question.

Four probe runs used the guest's real Chromium profile before the explicit --user-data-dir switch was added (dev-a, dev-b, dev-c, dev-a2); the guest home is disposable and credential-free, and the stray directory is left as evidence.
